scientific_estimand.risk_state: pair has not yet appeared in the available strict-binding database by the beginning of year tau
events: first strict-binding record is numeric weak or explicitly inactive
scientific_estimand.censoring: pair remains absent at the end of the historical window; absence is never an inactive label
scientific_estimand.primary_query: given an existing/old drug at time tau, rank targets by future active-event cumulative incidence
scientific_estimand.secondary_query: given a target at time tau, rank drugs by future active-event cumulative incidence

model.drug_input: Morgan radius 2, 2048 bits, computed from standardized parent SMILES
model.shared_pair_encoder: two 256-dimensional adapters plus normalized product, absolute difference and low-rank bilinear interaction
model.observation_hazard: discrete-year sigmoid hazard that a previously absent pair receives its first strict-binding record
model.conditional_outcome: sigmoid probability that the first record is active conditional on observation
model.primary_loss: exact discrete-time first-event competing-risk likelihood with sampled right-censored risk-set pairs
model.retrieval_auxiliary: within-drug listwise softmax over future active events versus same-year at-risk targets
model.secondary_no_harm: within-target retrieval loss and target-macro development noninferiority constraint
model.structure_extension: not used in Phase A; later only as label-independent eligibility-controlled residual with exact fallback

risk_set_rules.drug_entry_year: earliest strict-binding document year for that standardized compound, computed inside the historical source available to the fold
risk_set_rules.target_entry_year: earliest strict-binding document year for that benchmark sequence, computed inside the historical source available to the fold
risk_set_rules.pair_entry_year: maximum of drug and target entry years
risk_set_rules.event_year: minimum document year of the collapsed strict-binding pair
risk_set_rules.unobserved_sampling: four targets per observed event within drug plus four drugs per observed event within target, deterministic seed and inverse sampling-probability weight
risk_set_rules.future_event_exclusion: a future event may be sampled as censored only up to the fold cutoff; its future label/type is never exposed to training

locked_pressure_test.reason: S4 labels and baseline results were already inspected before this candidate was designed

controls: static observed-only BCE with the same pair encoder
static FNML-style observation/outcome dual head without event time or risk-set survival
single-event survival without active/inactive competing causes

training.selection_metric: equal mean of drug-macro AUPRC and drug-macro Recall@20 across the two historical development windows

phase_a_mechanism_gates_all_required: all timestamp, risk-set, entity and future-label leakage audits pass
full model exceeds static BCE on drug-macro AUPRC or Recall@20 in both development windows
full model exceeds static FNML-style control in both development windows
drug-cluster bootstrap 95% confidence lower bound for the pooled primary gain is greater than zero
target-macro AUPRC is no worse than the strongest control by more than 0.005
full model exceeds timestamp-shuffled full model
event cumulative-incidence predictions are finite and lie in [0,1]
success_action: freeze implementation hashes, run five seeds, then open the reused 2023-2025 pressure test exactly once

novelty_boundary.candidate_joint_mechanism: DTI first-observation active/inactive competing-event likelihood plus old-drug retrieval and later evidence-qualified exact fallback
